title: signal_fix and run skills must write workflow-unaware completion events to .moeb/events/
description:
signal_fix and run complete with no durable, machine-readable output. Any external tool that needs to react to a moeb skill completion — whether it is a conductor, a CI step, or a developer script — must poll git branches or the signal catalogue, creating fragile coupling to moeb internals. A structured event file written on completion gives any watcher a reliable detection point with no knowledge required of moeb's internal state.

Note: this signal replaces the in-scope portion of a1000010. That signal's proposed workflow_id field is outside moeb's boundary — moeb does not own workflows and should not carry orchestrator IDs. Mapping event signal_ids to workflow_ids is the conductor's responsibility (see Ouro signal b0000010).
proposed_resolution:
On completion (success or failure) each skill writes a JSON event file to .moeb/events/, creating the directory if absent. File name: {iso_timestamp_compact}_{signal_id_or_run_id}.event.json.

Fields for signal_fix events: event_type (signal_fixed | signal_fix_failed), signal_id, fix_branch, timestamp. On failure also include a reason field.

Fields for run events: event_type (run_completed | run_failed), run_id, signal_id (nullable — read from the run file written by a1000046), candidate_tag (nullable — read from the run file written by a1000046), timestamp. On failure also include a reason field.

No workflow_id or any other external-system ID is written — those belong to the caller. Document the event schema in .moeb/README.md alongside the run file schema.
